page_title: LEN 2-1 MAR | Lens v Marseille 25/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the left post.
90+5' Emerson (Marseille) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
90+2' Lens take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+1' Great touch by Mamadou Sangare (Lens) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save! Lens win a corner.
90+1' Emerson (Marseille) is caught offside!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
88' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Stephanie Frappart ignores the protests.
87' Stephanie Frappart shows a yellow card to Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) for his blatant foul.
86' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
86' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
86' Emerson (Marseille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) comes onto the pitch so that Ruben Aguilar can be given a rest.
84' Stephanie Frappart shows the yellow card to Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) for a heavy challenge.
83' The ball is laid off to Abdallah Sima (Lens) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Geronimo Rulli to make a decent save.
81' Pierre Sage decides to make a substitution. Odsonne Edouard will be replaced by Rayan Fofana (Lens).
81' Substitution. Abdallah Sima (Lens) on for Florian Thauvin.
81' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
80' Igor Paixao (Marseille) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. It will be a corner kick for Marseille.
80' A pass from Ruben Aguilar (Lens) is intercepted by Geronimo Rulli and the move breaks down.
78' Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Risser comes off his line to gather the ball.
75' Shots on target – 3:3.

74' Emerson (Marseille) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
74' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Michael Murillo and he is replaced by Angel Gomes (Marseille).
74' Here comes a substitution. Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Marseille) is brought on as a substitute for Matt O'Riley.
73' Morgan Guilavogui (Lens) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Stephanie Frappart stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.

71' Samson Baidoo (Lens) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the resulting corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly over the crossbar.
71' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
69' Substitution. Wesley Said makes way for Morgan Guilavogui (Lens).
65' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
65' Emerson (Marseille) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
65' Emerson (Marseille) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
64' Michael Murillo (Marseille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Marseille force their opponents to concede a corner.

62' Florian Thauvin (Lens) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Geronimo Rulli shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
61' Here's the change. Benjamin Pavard leaves the pitch and Bilal Nadir (Marseille) comes on as a substitute.
59' A rebound falls kindly for Michael Murillo (Marseille), but his shot from the edge of the box flies high over bar. None too pretty!
57' Some great controlled play and passing from Marseille. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
55' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Marseille.

54' Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Robin Risser is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Marseille are awarded a corner kick.

53' 2 - 1 It's an own goal! A pitiful moment for Benjamin Pavard (Marseille), who tries to clear a cross into the six-yard box from the corner but instead sends the ball behind his own keeper. The score is 2:1.
53' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lens.
52' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Timothy Weah limps off the pitch to be replaced by Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille).
52' Substitution. Pierre-Emerick Aubameyang (Marseille) in, Robinio Vaz out.
50' Looks like Timothy Weah (Marseille) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
47' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Stephanie Frappart has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Lens take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

45+2' Mamadou Sangare (Lens) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Geronimo Rulli was alert and the score remains the same. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lens.
45+2' The resulting corner from Emerson (Marseille) is cleared by the defence.

45+1' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Igor Paixao (Marseille). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The ball is out of play and Marseille manage to earn a corner.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Flag up against Odsonne Edouard (Lens). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
42' Florian Thauvin (Lens) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
41' A fine individual run by Florian Thauvin (Lens) culminates with a rocket of a shot from long range, but the ball fizzes just wide of the right post.
39' Malang Sarr (Lens) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for an infringement.
38' Igor Paixao (Marseille) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
37' Marseille players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
34' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
33' Matthieu Udol (Lens) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
31' Matt O'Riley (Marseille) receives a pass and tries his luck with a long-range powerful effort. His poorly placed shot lacks accuracy and flies miles wide of the right post.
30' Timothy Weah (Marseille) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
27' Referee Stephanie Frappart sees the trip by Robinio Vaz (Marseille) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
26' Ball possession – 37:63.
23' 1 - 1 Odsonne Edouard (Lens) makes no mistake from the penalty spot after waiting for Geronimo Rulli to move before rolling the ball into the middle of the goal!
23' Odsonne Edouard (Lens) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
22' The foul by Benjamin Pavard (Marseille) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Stephanie Frappart.
22' The Lens players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
21' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Lens! Let's see what he decides.
20' PENALTY APPEAL after Odsonne Edouard (Lens) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

17' 0 - 1 It's in! Timothy Weah spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Mason Greenwood (Marseille) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 0:1.
14' A spell of possession for Marseille in an attempt to control the game.
11' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Mamadou Sangare (Lens) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
8' Adrien Thomasson (Lens) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
7' Emerson (Marseille) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
6' The referee blows his whistle, Marseille are awarded a corner kick.
6' This shall not pass! Igor Paixao (Marseille) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
4' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.

2' Robinio Vaz (Marseille) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the right post.
1' Ruben Aguilar (Lens) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Lens will take the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
